sources.title: georgep23/sheffield-collisions-models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Sheffield Road Collision Models Trained model artefacts for the Traffic-AIproject: a multi-task ML pipeline over UK Department for Transport STATS19 collision records filtered to Sheffield. Includes multiclass and binary classifiers, regressors, and clustering models saved with pickle, plus the models.jsonregistry that the project's CLI uses to discover them.
